This is a verification pass on an ALREADY-SHIPPED change: routing correctness, guard-test health, evidence synthesis, and a ship-or-revert verdict on the evidence available today. Likely proximate cause: accounts.json's grid.map metadata still read 'risky-1: risky x tight' (never updated in that commit, even though the arm's own `cell` field was) -- since fixed.
correction_2026_08_02_later_same_night.already_on_record_before_this_audit_ran: queue.md's FLEET-PARITY-TESTS-READ-LIVE-STATE entry (commit dea5b2e2, ~02:00 ET the SAME night, hours before this audit's 01:53 timestamp reads oddly close but this fix landed in the following session) independently found and fixed a test asserting the same stale premise, with the note 'risky-1 ... its normal lane is now UNGATED same as risky-3.'
correction_2026_08_02_later_same_night.corrected_composition: risky-1's normal lane is UNGATED (fx._gate_check has no min_triggers/confluence left to check) and now prices ATM via bold_core for ANY passing signal -- the same population class as risky-3/bold-2's own entries, not a narrow ELITE-only subset. At risky-1's current equity (<$2K) this coincides numerically with the FULL-SEND lane's own PROBE_STRIKE_TIERS pricing (both ATM) -- verified EQUITY-CONTINGENT, not structural: the tables diverge at/above $2,000 (bold_core->OTM-2, PROBE_STRIKE_TIERS->stays ATM to $10K). The two lanes remain population-disjoint (full-send requires an action on its own 5-verdict allowlist, mutually exclusive with a normally-passing tick) and separately tagged (EntryPlan.reason 'FULL_SEND ...' vs 'strategy side (quality)'), so per-fill attribution between the two 07-31 experiments is intact despite this error.
correction_2026_08_02_later_same_night.does_this_change_the_verdict: No. KEEP AS SHIPPED still stands -- routing is still correct, guards are still green, the change is still paper/one-line-revertible. What changes is the DESCRIPTION of how large a population risky-1's normal lane now touches (larger than 'tight-gated' implied) and the disclosure that full-send and bold_core are two DIFFERENT-but-currently-coincident mechanisms on one arm, not that one silently substitutes the other.
correction_2026_08_02_later_same_night.action_taken: accounts.json grid.map + a map_doc pointer fixed; a lane_scoping_addendum filed on fleet-strike-tier-atm-extension-prereg-2026-08-01.json requiring risky-1's future bold_core scorecard to exclude reason-tagged FULL_SEND fills from its own n>=20 cohort; guard tests automation/state/fleet/test_risky1_lane_composition_check.py (9/9, RED-proofed on the grid.map fix); ADDITIONAL finding flagged (not fixed): risky-3's own gate_params.hard_skip_verdicts=[] rescue is empirically dead on the live plan_all path (fleet_live.py never calls plan_entry, the only caller of _effective_passed).

evidence: crypto/lib/strike_selection.py's own V15_BOLD_CORE_TIERS docstring: 'this was a PARTICIPATION fix... not a claim that the P&L evidence cleared all 5 auto-ratify gates; that regime-parked evidence is unchanged and still honestly disclosed as such.'

analysis/recommendations/bold-strike-axis-2026-07-15.json (the underlying study, re-read in full this session): ALL 6 strike cells (OTM-3..ITM-2) show ship_ready=false. ATM fails only wf_ge_070, but that gate is STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE for this entire cohort+shape (near_miss_diagnostic.wf_gate_structural_finding: every cell's IS-half mean is negative under this convention, so wf=oos_mean/is_mean is undefined by construction -- not unique to ATM). The study's own verdict label for ATM: 'WATCH -- NOT ship-ready... a near-miss worth a human/Fable look, not a same-night or same-morning auto-ship.' 'not_applied: NOT edited in this session.'

The actual 2026-07-17/18 core-Bold ship required J's EXPLICIT in-chat authorization ('Yes -- wire Bold to ATM') specifically because the P&L gates hadn't cleared -- confirmed by strike_selection.py's docstring citing that authorization as what superseded the 'WF-gate-pending hold'.
framing_correction.corrected_framing: V15_BOLD_CORE_TIERS is VALIDATED MACHINERY (guard-tested, live-run since 07-17/18, no incidents) but its underlying P&L CASE never cleared full auto-ratify validation -- it shipped, and now extends, on the TRADE-TO-LEARN doctrine (paper, guarded, one-line-revertible, forward-evidence-pending), which is a legitimate and precedented pattern in this repo (score-ladder, full-send both shipped the same way) -- but must be reported as what it is, not oversold as a validated P&L edge.

re_measurement_attempt.finding: TOOL-POPULATION MISMATCH -- disclosed, not used as the primary instrument for this question.
re_measurement_attempt.detail: Read the tool's full source. It hardcodes core-Bold's OWN gate profile from aggressive/params.json inside bold_base_live() (min_triggers_bear=1/min_triggers_bull=1, no confluence requirement, block_bull_1100_1200=False, entry_bar_body_pct_min=0.0, require_bearish_fill_bar=True) and only equity is exposed as an overridable parameter (via resolve_bold_strike_offset/resolve_bold_qty). None of risky-1's TIGHT gate_override (min_triggers=2 + require_confluence_or_sequence) or risky-3's LOOSE gate_override (min_triggers=1 + gate_params.hard_skip_verdicts=[], which additionally makes risky-3 IGNORE require_bearish_fill_bar -- looser than core Bold's own gate) is modeled. It also only re-derives exit P&L for the ribbon_ride strategy, not vwap_continuation (which both fleet arms also trade per strategies.py REGISTRY). Running it with equity overridden to $1,756.87 or $2,121.61 would answer 'what would core Bold's OWN population look like at a fleet arm's equity' -- a different and less useful question than 'what does risky-1/risky-3's OWN gated population look like' -- and risks the exact OP-16 sim-accuracy failure mode this repo's own doctrine warns against (cites the BS-sim-ignored-strike-offset incident that 'invalidated a weekend of research'). Ran --anchor-only as a tool-health sanity check only (6/7 real bold-2 fills reproduce within tolerance, all_pass=false on the 07-28 case -- consistent with the tool's own documented tolerance framework, not evidence about the fleet-arm question).
re_measurement_attempt.correct_tool_identified_but_not_extended: backtest/replay_fleet_arms.py already exists and DOES faithfully construct each arm's own gated entry population (injects min_triggers_bear/bull from the arm's gate_override, applies direction_lock/confluence filters, routes SAFE vs BOLD base params exactly like fleet_executor._base_params_for) -- but its own docstring states strike/qty are explicitly OUT of scope ('a separate parity check, not the gate'); it only validates ENTRY TIMING fidelity, never re-derives exit P&L by strike tier. Extending it with an exit-P&L layer (borrowing bold_fullhist_replay.py's walk_exit_manager pattern) would be the correct purpose-built tool for this exact question. NOT built this session -- see recommended_followup below for why, and a spawned task for the build itself.
re_measurement_attempt.why_not_built_this_session: Any such backtest would be fundamentally UNANCHORED at the ATM strike specifically, because zero real fleet fills exist at ATM pricing for these arms (that is the entire reason this is a forward paper experiment). This is the same limitation this repo's own full-send-arm-2026-07-31.md already established in near-identical language: 'the incremental trades this arm adds have NO valid measurement at their actual strike. Its forward paper ledger is the evidence, and nothing else here is.' Building elaborate new machinery under time pressure to produce a number that can't be anchor-validated at the strike in question would add false precision, not real evidence -- and this repo's culture has been burned by exactly that shape of mistake twice already this same week (the elite-bull-requal mislabeled-cohort correction, the full-send biased-ratio-estimator correction), both found only via adversarial re-review AFTER initial shipping.

bold_strike_axis_2026_07_15.population: Core Bold's OWN gate profile (Gamma-Risky-2 / bold-2), NOT any fleet arm's -- confirmed via the study's own header: 'Gamma-Risky-2's <$2K tier'.
bold_strike_axis_2026_07_15.finding: ATM: OOS +$28.77/tr, floor-clearance 96.88% afternoon vs OTM-3's 33.76%, sub_window_stable=true, BH-FDR survivor. Fails only the structurally-unreachable WF gate. ship_ready=false, verdict WATCH not auto-ship.

min_entry_premium_2026_07_31.population: The ACTUAL fleet-arm-specific cohort -- every SKIP_MIN_PREMIUM_FLOOR row on safe-3/risky-1/risky-3, 2026-07-28..07-31, replayed via real OPRA quotes + the real exit_manager, AT EACH ARM'S OWN EXISTING (OTM) STRIKE -- i.e. the counterfactual 'what if the floor hadn't blocked these, still priced OTM' not 'what if these were priced ATM'.
min_entry_premium_2026_07_31.finding: n=25 cells, total -$145.20, -$5.81/tr, still negative on drop-best (-$9.59/tr). By arm: safe-3 n=8 +$27.40 WR=0.50; risky-1 n=10 -$92.10 WR=0.40; risky-3 n=7 -$80.50 WR=0.1429. Disclosed as small-n anecdote, not auto-ratify-eligible.
min_entry_premium_2026_07_31.caveat: This measures the blocked cohort at the OLD (OTM) strike, not the NEW (ATM) strike the ship actually prices. Directionally relevant (same underlying signals were mildly negative even before repricing) but not a direct measurement of the shipped change.

full_send_arm_2026_07_31_counter_precede.population: A related but DISTINCT mechanism -- risky-1's full-send lane, a min-size cohort-BYPASS population (5 explicit vetoed-cohort allowlist), priced OTM-2 vs ATM. Not the same population as the bold_core NORMAL-lane change, but the closest real, on-strike, real-OPRA-fills precedent in this repo for 'push a fleet arm's marginal cohort's strike toward ATM'.
full_send_arm_2026_07_31_counter_precede.finding: Full population (387 sessions): OTM-2 +$3,430 -> ATM -$5,110 (327 trades, near-flat vs 332). Recent 25 (51 sessions): OTM-2 +$118 -> ATM -$1,088 (79 trades vs 78). Near-identical trade counts, dramatically worse P&L at the nearer strike.
full_send_arm_2026_07_31_counter_precede.why_it_does_not_directly_contradict_the_: The full-send cohort is EXPLICITLY the lower-conviction, cohort-vetoed population (signals the engine's own quality gates rejected). risky-1's bold_core NORMAL lane is the OPPOSITE selectivity direction -- TIGHTER than core Bold's own gate (min_triggers=2+confluence required, vs Bold's min_triggers=1 no confluence). Higher-conviction populations are the ones bold-strike-axis-2026-07-15 found ATM favorable for; this precedent is closer to the ATM-hurts-marginal-cohorts mechanism, which argues MORE for risky-3's loose/hard-skip-bypassed population (a genuinely closer analog to the vetoed cohort) than for risky-1's tight one -- but risky-3 is currently a no-op, so this risk is not live today.
full_send_arm_2026_07_31_counter_precede.why_it_still_matters: It is direct, on-the-record, real-OPRA-fills evidence in THIS repo that 'nearer strike -> more participation' does not reliably mean 'better P&L' once a cohort is marginal/low-conviction. Should sharpen vigilance on the forward evaluation, not be dismissed.

verdict.decision: KEEP AS SHIPPED. NO REVERT. NO CODE CHANGE.
rationale: Mechanically correct: routing verified via direct source read, matches the pre-reg's stated scope exactly (risky-1/risky-3 only, safe-3 explicitly excluded), guard-tested with genuine bidirectional vary-and-assert coverage, re-confirmed green (42/42) fresh this session.

Paper-only, one-line-revertible (delete 'strike_tier_table':'bold_core' from risky-1/risky-3's params_patch), every downstream risk guard (kill switch, per-trade cap, PDT, one-position, EOD flatten, floor) untouched and independently guard-tested.

Consistent with this repo's own established TRADE-TO-LEARN doctrine: validated machinery (V15_BOLD_CORE_TIERS itself has been live on core Bold since 07-17/18 with no incidents) may arm on paper before its own P&L case fully clears, to collect forward evidence -- the same pattern already used for score-ladder and full-send.
No NEW evidence has emerged (zero fills, zero trading sessions) that would justify reverting a harmless, bounded, already-armed experiment before it has even had a chance to run.

The full-send counter-precedent is real and disclosed, but it is evidence about a DIFFERENT (cohort-vetoed, lower-conviction) population, not a direct measurement of risky-1's tight-gated normal lane -- it argues for vigilance in the forward evaluation, not for an immediate revert on a population it didn't actually measure.
